nodes.title: Squad Payment Modal
nodes.summary: This document describes the Squad Payment Modal, an easy and convenient payment flow for securely collecting payments from customers.

nodes.title: Payment Modal
nodes.summary: Explains that the Squad Payment Modal provides a simple way to collect payments securely without customers leaving the website.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: Lists and describes the parameters required to initialize a transaction, including required fields like email, amount, and currency, and other optional fields.

nodes.title: Code Glossary
nodes.summary: Introduces the code examples that follow, showcasing HTML and JavaScript for integrating the payment modal.

nodes.title: HTML Form Example
nodes.summary: Provides an HTML code example for a simple checkout form to collect customer details such as email, amount, first name, and last name.

nodes.title: SquadPay Function
nodes.summary: Defines the JavaScript `SquadPay` function that initializes the Squad payment widget with transaction details and opens the modal.

nodes.title: Initiate transaction
nodes.summary: Explains how to initiate a transaction using the provided JavaScript function when the customer clicks a submit button, passing required parameters.

nodes.title: Initiate Transaction Code Example
nodes.summary: Provides a JavaScript code example of the `SquadPay` function to illustrate how to initiate a transaction and open the payment modal programmatically.

nodes.title: Checkout Demo
nodes.summary: Demonstrates how to initiate a transaction using a POST request to the Squad API endpoint, including details for payment.

nodes.title: cURL Initiate Transaction Example
nodes.summary: Provides a cURL command example for initiating a transaction directly via the Squad API, specifying amount, email, and merchant key.

nodes.title: Key Information
nodes.summary: Highlights important details regarding the 'key' field usage and the 'amount' field's currency unit conversion (kobo/cent).

nodes.title: Payment channels
nodes.summary: Introduces the various payment channels available to customers to complete transactions after the payment modal is initialized.

nodes.title: USSD
nodes.summary: Describes the USSD payment channel, enabling Nigerian customers to pay by dialing a code on their mobile devices, with responses sent to webhooks.

nodes.title: Banks Supported
nodes.summary: Lists all Nigerian banks and their corresponding USSD shortcodes currently supported by the Squad payment system for USSD transactions.

nodes.title: Bank Transfer
nodes.summary: Explains the Bank Transfer payment method, which allows customers to pay through a direct bank account transfer to a preset account number.

nodes.title: Card
nodes.summary: Describes the Card payment method, enabling customers to complete payments by providing their card number, expiry date, and CVV.

nodes.title: How To Test
nodes.summary: Provides a step-by-step guide on how to test the Squad Payment Modal using a sandbox account and local HTML file.

nodes.title: Go live
nodes.summary: Instructs users on how to transition from test mode to live production by replacing the test public key with the live key from the Squad dashboard.
